packageRules.description: Batch runtime, test and docs dependencies into one low-noise PR.
Lockstep the version-sensitive lint tools so local == CI stays true after an upgrade. prek pins the builtin hooks' implementations, so it moves with the linters.
Pin the template's action refs to commit SHAs, matching what helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests already does to the rendered workflows downstream. A tag is a label its owner can move; a SHA is not.

customManagers.description: Bump versions annotated with a `# renovate:` comment (the pinned uv, nox, git-cliff, gitleaks, cyclonedx-bom and twine versions that no built-in manager reads). Covers rendered workflows AND the python-package-copier template sources that generate them: Renovate cannot see `.jinja` files, so the template's own seeds aged while every repo it generated moved ahead, and each fan-out then re-seeded a stale value into repos that had already passed it.

Keep the python-package-copier template's own `uses:` refs current, and pinned to digests. Renovate's github-actions manager reads `.github/workflows/*.yml`, so it maintains the workflows generated projects RUN but never the `.jinja` sources they are generated FROM: the template's refs moved only when a human edited a hand-written map, and every fan-out re-seeded whatever that human last wrote. Pinning here rather than only downstream keeps one notation on both sides -- with the template on tags and the fleet on digests, both moving, every action major bump would collide in seven repos at once.
